F_PUTNAM_1_reproducibility.name: verdict reproducibility across 3 independent runs at fixed T

F_PUTNAM_2_single_axis_robustness.name: verdict drops by at most one tier when any single substrate axis is removed
F_PUTNAM_2_single_axis_robustness.procedure: for each of the 5 phi-bearing substrates, remove from concordance set, recompute, record verdict
F_PUTNAM_2_single_axis_robustness.honest_c3: Baseline is already FAIL tier; tier drop bounded below by definition. Robustness check is non-binding while baseline is at min tier; will become substantive once Phase 2 raises baseline above FAIL.

F_PUTNAM_3_threshold_sensitivity.name: T_putnam ±0.05 perturbation does not change verdict tier by more than 1 step
F_PUTNAM_3_threshold_sensitivity.knife_edge_check: T=0.35 yields FAIL AND T=0.45 yields FAIL → no full-range tier swing
F_PUTNAM_3_threshold_sensitivity.honest_c3: Verifier emits identical concordance=0.333 across T sweep because verifier hardcodes BLM Phase 4 RETRY values (CLM=30.86, BOLD=21.33, EEG=-3.01) and the only T_phi values are 0.309 (CLM-BOLD pass under all 3 T's), 1.098 (CLM-EEG fail under all 3), 1.141 (BOLD-EEG fail under all 3). T sweep is non-discriminating in this cycle's data. F-PUTNAM-3 PASS but uninformative until concordance crosses a T boundary in Phase 2.

F_PUTNAM_4_F2_unfire_dependency.name: if F2 fires (Phase E not yet) → max verdict = PARTIAL
F_PUTNAM_4_F2_unfire_dependency.procedure: check (verdict, F2_state) tuple from verifier output
F_PUTNAM_4_F2_unfire_dependency.tuple_check: (FAIL, FIRES) → consistent with rule (verdict ∈ {PARTIAL, FAIL} when F2_state == FIRES)
F_PUTNAM_4_F2_unfire_dependency.violation: verdict == PASS while F2_state == FIRES would FAIL
F_PUTNAM_4_F2_unfire_dependency.honest_c3: Verdict is FAIL not PARTIAL because concordance gate (0.333 < 0.40) fires before F2 ceiling kicks in. Either gate alone (concordance < 0.40 OR f2 == FIRES) is sufficient to block PASS in current data.

F_PUTNAM_5_qmirror_cond6_inclusion.qmirror_in_n_witnessed_count_evidence: header anchor 'qmirror_canonical_2026_05_03' + 'adds_qmirror_as_cross_substrate_witness_axis' contributes +1 to count_witnessed_axes() per verifier impl
